scenario: AITA for reducing my tip to compensate for a drink I didn’t order? When I pointed this out to the waitress she said water was a beverage and I needed to pay for it. My girlfriend thinks it was an asshole move and I think I’m not paying $2 for lukewarm tap water. basically I brought my cheque total to the $12.50 it would have originally been without the water added.
